code_block:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: frappe-crm-config
  namespace: frappe-crm
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: frappe-crm
data:
  # ---- MariaDB ----
  # Must match the Kubernetes Service name for mariadb (05-mariadb-service.yaml)
  MARIADB_HOST: "mariadb"
  MARIADB_PORT: "3306"

  # ---- Redis ----
  # Using a single Redis instance (matches docker/docker-compose.yml pattern).
  # Must match the Kubernetes Service name for redis (07-redis-service.yaml).
  REDIS_CACHE_URL: "redis://redis:6379"
  REDIS_QUEUE_URL: "redis://redis:6379"
  REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL: "redis://redis:6379"

  # ---- Frappe Site ----
  FRAPPE_SITE_NAME: "crm.localhost"
  FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION: "version-15"
  DEVELOPER_MODE: "1"
  MUTE_EMAILS: "1"
  SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED: "1"

  # ---- Init script (embedded as a ConfigMap key) ----
  # This is mounted into the InitContainer and run once to set up the bench.
  # It is equivalent to docker/init.sh, adapted for Kubernetes (secrets from env).
  init.sh: |
    #!/bin/bash
    set -e

    export PATH="/home/frappe/.nvm/current/bin/:/home/frappe/.local/bin:/home/frappe/.pyenv/shims:/home/frappe/.pyenv/bin:$PATH"

    # Configure MariaDB client to disable SSL by default
    echo -e '[client]\nssl=0' > /home/frappe/.my.cnf

    echo "=== Frappe CRM Kubernetes Init Script ==="
    echo "Site: ${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}"
    echo "MariaDB host: ${MARIADB_HOST}"

    # Wait for MariaDB to be ready
    echo "Waiting for MariaDB..."
    until mysqladmin ping -h "${MARIADB_HOST}" -u root -p"${MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD}" --skip-ssl --silent 2>/dev/null; do
      echo "  MariaDB not ready yet, retrying in 5s..."
      sleep 5
    done
    echo "MariaDB is ready."

    # Wait for Redis to be ready
    echo "Waiting for Redis..."
    until redis-cli -u "${REDIS_CACHE_URL}" ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG; do
      echo "  Redis not ready yet, retrying in 5s..."
      sleep 5
    done
    echo "Redis is ready."

    # If bench already exists (e.g. pod restart), skip init
    if [ -d "/home/frappe/frappe-bench/apps/frappe" ]; then
      echo "Bench already initialised — skipping bench init."
    else
      echo "Initialising bench..."
      cd /home/frappe
      bench init \
        --ignore-exist \
        --skip-redis-config-generation \
        frappe-bench \
        --version "${FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION}"
    fi

    cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench

    # Configure external services
    bench set-mariadb-host "${MARIADB_HOST}"
    bench set-redis-cache-host "${REDIS_CACHE_URL}"
    bench set-redis-queue-host "${REDIS_QUEUE_URL}"
    bench set-redis-socketio-host "${REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL}"

    # Remove redis and watch from Procfile (we provide external Redis)
    sed -i '/redis/d' ./Procfile
    sed -i '/watch/d'  ./Procfile

    # Fetch the CRM app if not present
    if [ ! -d "apps/crm" ]; then
      echo "Fetching CRM app..."
      bench get-app crm --branch main
    fi

    # Create site if it does not exist
    if bench --site "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}" show-config 2>/dev/null | grep -q db_name; then
      echo "Site ${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME} already exists — skipping site creation."
    else
      echo "Creating site ${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}..."
      bench new-site "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}" \
        --force \
        --mariadb-root-password "${MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD}" \
        --admin-password "${FRAPPE_ADMIN_PASSWORD}" \
        --no-mariadb-socket
      bench --site "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}" install-app crm
      bench --site "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}" set-config developer_mode "${DEVELOPER_MODE}"
      bench --site "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}" set-config mute_emails "${MUTE_EMAILS}"
      bench --site "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}" set-config server_script_enabled "${SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED}"
      bench --site "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}" clear-cache
      bench use "${FRAPPE_SITE_NAME}"
    fi

    echo "=== Init complete. Bench is ready. ==="

passed_checks.check_name: Minimize the admission of containers with added capability
code_block:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: mariadb
  namespace: frappe-crm
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: frappe-crm
    app.kubernetes.io/component: mariadb
spec:
  serviceName: "mariadb"  # Must match the headless Service name
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: mariadb
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: mariadb
        app.kubernetes.io/name: frappe-crm
        app.kubernetes.io/component: mariadb
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: mariadb
          image: mariadb:10.6
          # Flags derived from docker/docker-compose.yml and .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml
          args:
            - --character-set-server=utf8mb4
            - --collation-server=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            - --skip-character-set-client-handshake
            - --skip-innodb-read-only-compressed
          ports:
            - name: mysql
              containerPort: 3306
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-secrets
                  key: MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD
          volumeMounts:
            - name: mariadb-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/mysql
          # ---- Health Checks ----
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - bash
                - -c
                - "mysqladmin ping -u root -p\"${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}\" --silent"
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - bash
                - -c
                - "mysqladmin ping -u root -p\"${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}\" --silent"
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          # ---- Resource Requests & Limits ----
          # Conservative sizing for internship demo.
          # Increase for production workloads.
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"       # 0.25 vCPU
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "1000m"      # 1 vCPU
              memory: "1Gi"
      volumes:
        - name: mariadb-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: mariadb-data

code_block:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frappe
  namespace: frappe-crm
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: frappe-crm
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frappe
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frappe
  strategy:
    type: Recreate   # Avoid two pods trying to run bench start simultaneously
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frappe
        app.kubernetes.io/name: frappe-crm
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frappe
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
      # ---- Init Container ----
      # Runs the init.sh script from the ConfigMap before the main container starts.
      # This ensures MariaDB is ready and the site is created before bench start.
      initContainers:
        # Step 1: Ensure persistent volume is owned by frappe user (uid 1000)
        - name: fix-permissions
          image: frappe/bench:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["bash", "-c", "chown -R frappe:frappe /home/frappe/frappe-bench && chmod -R 775 /home/frappe/frappe-bench"]
          securityContext:
            runAsUser: 0
          volumeMounts:
            - name: frappe-bench-data
              mountPath: /home/frappe/frappe-bench
        # Step 2: Initialize bench and CRM site
        - name: frappe-init
          image: frappe/bench:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["bash", "/workspace/init.sh"]
          env:
            # Injected from ConfigMap (non-sensitive)
            - name: MARIADB_HOST
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: MARIADB_HOST
            - name: REDIS_CACHE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_CACHE_URL
            - name: REDIS_QUEUE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_QUEUE_URL
            - name: REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL
            - name: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
            - name: FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION
            - name: DEVELOPER_MODE
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: DEVELOPER_MODE
            - name: MUTE_EMAILS
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: MUTE_EMAILS
            - name: SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED
            # Injected from Secret (sensitive)
            - name: MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-secrets
                  key: MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD
            - name: FRAPPE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-secrets
                  key: FRAPPE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
          volumeMounts:
            - name: frappe-bench-data
              mountPath: /home/frappe/frappe-bench
            # Mount the init.sh from ConfigMap into /workspace/init.sh
            - name: init-script
              mountPath: /workspace/init.sh
              subPath: init.sh
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "2Gi"

      # ---- Main Container ----
      containers:
        - name: frappe
          image: frappe/bench:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          # bench start launches gunicorn, socketio, workers, scheduler
          # working directory is the frappe-bench created by InitContainer
          command: ["bash", "-c", "cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench && bench start"]
          env:
            - name: SHELL
              value: "/bin/bash"
            - name: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000   # Gunicorn (Frappe web)
              protocol: TCP
            - name: socketio
              containerPort: 9000   # Node.js SocketIO / WebSocket
              protocol: TCP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: frappe-bench-data
              mountPath: /home/frappe/frappe-bench
          # ---- Health Checks ----
          # bench start takes 2-5 minutes on first boot (app fetch + site creation
          # happens in InitContainer, but gunicorn startup still takes ~30s).
          # Use generous initialDelaySeconds to avoid premature restarts.
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/method/ping
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 120
            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/method/ping
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 5
          # ---- Resource Requests & Limits ----
          # Frappe (gunicorn + workers + scheduler + socketio) is memory-hungry.
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "1Gi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "3Gi"

      # ---- Volumes ----
      volumes:
        - name: frappe-bench-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: frappe-bench-data
        - name: init-script
          configMap:
            name: frappe-crm-config
            items:
              - key: init.sh
                path: init.sh
            defaultMode: 0755   # Make the script executable

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frappe
  namespace: frappe-crm
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: frappe-crm
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frappe
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frappe
  strategy:
    type: Recreate   # Avoid two pods trying to run bench start simultaneously
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frappe
        app.kubernetes.io/name: frappe-crm
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frappe
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
      # ---- Init Container ----
      # Runs the init.sh script from the ConfigMap before the main container starts.
      # This ensures MariaDB is ready and the site is created before bench start.
      initContainers:
        # Step 1: Ensure persistent volume is owned by frappe user (uid 1000)
        - name: fix-permissions
          image: frappe/bench:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["bash", "-c", "chown -R frappe:frappe /home/frappe/frappe-bench && chmod -R 775 /home/frappe/frappe-bench"]
          securityContext:
            runAsUser: 0
          volumeMounts:
            - name: frappe-bench-data
              mountPath: /home/frappe/frappe-bench
        # Step 2: Initialize bench and CRM site
        - name: frappe-init
          image: frappe/bench:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["bash", "/workspace/init.sh"]
          env:
            # Injected from ConfigMap (non-sensitive)
            - name: MARIADB_HOST
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: MARIADB_HOST
            - name: REDIS_CACHE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_CACHE_URL
            - name: REDIS_QUEUE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_QUEUE_URL
            - name: REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL
            - name: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
            - name: FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION
            - name: DEVELOPER_MODE
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: DEVELOPER_MODE
            - name: MUTE_EMAILS
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: MUTE_EMAILS
            - name: SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED
            # Injected from Secret (sensitive)
            - name: MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-secrets
                  key: MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD
            - name: FRAPPE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-secrets
                  key: FRAPPE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
          volumeMounts:
            - name: frappe-bench-data
              mountPath: /home/frappe/frappe-bench
            # Mount the init.sh from ConfigMap into /workspace/init.sh
            - name: init-script
              mountPath: /workspace/init.sh
              subPath: init.sh
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "2Gi"

      # ---- Main Container ----
      containers:
        - name: frappe
          image: frappe/bench:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          # bench start launches gunicorn, socketio, workers, scheduler
          # working directory is the frappe-bench created by InitContainer
          command: ["bash", "-c", "cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench && bench start"]
          env:
            - name: SHELL
              value: "/bin/bash"
            - name: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000   # Gunicorn (Frappe web)
              protocol: TCP
            - name: socketio
              containerPort: 9000   # Node.js SocketIO / WebSocket
              protocol: TCP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: frappe-bench-data
              mountPath: /home/frappe/frappe-bench
          # ---- Health Checks ----
          # bench start takes 2-5 minutes on first boot (app fetch + site creation
          # happens in InitContainer, but gunicorn startup still takes ~30s).
          # Use generous initialDelaySeconds to avoid premature restarts.
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/method/ping
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 120
            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/method/ping
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 5
          # ---- Resource Requests & Limits ----
          # Frappe (gunicorn + workers + scheduler + socketio) is memory-hungry.
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "1Gi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "3Gi"

      # ---- Volumes ----
      volumes:
        - name: frappe-bench-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: frappe-bench-data
        - name: init-script
          configMap:
            name: frappe-crm-config
            items:
              - key: init.sh
                path: init.sh
            defaultMode: 0755   # Make the script executable

            - name: REDIS_CACHE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_CACHE_URL
            - name: REDIS_QUEUE_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_QUEUE_URL
            - name: REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: REDIS_SOCKETIO_URL
            - name: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME
            - name: FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_BENCH_VERSION
            - name: DEVELOPER_MODE
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: DEVELOPER_MODE
            - name: MUTE_EMAILS
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: MUTE_EMAILS
            - name: SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: SERVER_SCRIPT_ENABLED
            # Injected from Secret (sensitive)
            - name: MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD

            - name: FRAPPE_ADMIN_PASSWORD

                secretKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-secrets
                  key: FRAPPE_ADMIN_PASSWORD

              mountPath: /home/frappe/frappe-bench

            - name: init-script
              mountPath: /workspace/init.sh

              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: frappe-crm-config
                  key: FRAPPE_SITE_NAME

            - name: http

            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/method/ping
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 5
          # ---- Resource Requests & Limits ----

          resources:
            requests:

              memory: "1Gi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"

        - name: frappe-bench-data

            claimName: frappe-bench-data
        - name: init-script
          configMap:
            name: frappe-crm-config
            items:
              - key: init.sh
                path: init.sh
            defaultMode: 0755   # Make the script executable
